newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms on Central Bank dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms on Central Bank dlr sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed firmer at 468.75/470.00 per dollar Wednesday, compared to 471.00/472.00 per dollar Tuesday as the Central Bank sold dollars heavily, traders said.
"The Central Bank was present constantly and intervening strongly at low levels which we were not expecting," one trader said.
Traders said there was some corporate demand for currency but this was overwhelmed by supply from the Central Bank.
"The Central Bank entered from the start over and above the demand that there was today," one said.
